items.d: The building with a dome beside Ak Mosque is called Khan Anush Mohammed's Bath. The main part of it is subterranean in order to keep the walls steadily warm.

Do not miss the Karakalpakstan State Museum of Art's Igor Savitsky Collection with its unique collection of many thousands of works by dissenting artists from the Soviet Union during the period in which Stalinist socialist…

Songgot-bong is a sharp, pointed peak on the northwestern coast of Ulleungdo known for its dramatic cliffside appearance. Its name literally means “awl peak,” reflecting its needle-like silhouette rising from the sea.
Heine (1797-1856) was a poet and author and perhaps the most famed Düsseldorfer in German history
Has art from Northern Norway from 1800 onwards, and Norwegian art in general. Look out for their temporary exhibits.
This building was completed in 1882 and designed with a Venetian Renaissance style by architect W. B. Armson, one of the first professionally trained colonial architects to work in New Zealand.
Occupying a former orphanage, this art museum is a pleasant surprise in a town that can otherwise feel a long way from modern cultural pursuits.
The birthplace of hydroelectric power generation in Japan and features a functioning century-old hydroelectric plant (operating in a demonstration capacity) that remains connected to the power grid.

n.en: Sankyozawa Electric Centennial Museum (Sankyozawa 100 Year Electric Historical Center)

items.d: This shrine is famous for the more than 900-year-old Zelkova tree (keyaki) in its grounds. The shrine used to be on the banks of the Sai River, before land was reclaimed, and the tree was used as an anchor point for boats.
There are many smaller places where to swim in either the rivers or the lake, but the largest one is Genève Plage (literally "Geneva Beach") at the eastern bank of the lake.

Seo Market, located in Seogyo-dong, is the largest and traditional market in Yeosu for more than 100 years. It is a general market that sells various items such as marine products, clothing, and meat.
Climb it and enjoy the views.
This soccer club plays in the Israeli Premier League, the country's top tier. Their home ground is Sammy Ofer Stadium (capacity 30,700), 500 m inland from "Student Beach".
Closed for renovation until 2026A great museum on the history of Northern Ostrobothnia, especially the history of Oulu. Exhibitions on four floors.
The border post between Indonesia and Papua New Guinea. There is a lighthouse so you may watch Solomon beach, Wutung in Papua New Guinea from above.

The village(s) behind the Golden Rock are interesting and allow for some steep walks up and down along the ridge. You can buy little things, have a coffee, a sweet coconut drink or a Burmese meal, and look at the dead animal…
Attractive display of finds from the region, especially the carved sarcophagi and discoveries at Çatalhöyük.

Founded in 1695 but in relatively poor condition today. It contains two churches, one dedicated to St Michael the Archangel and the other dedicated to St Mary. The former is the main church of the monastery and was built in 1861.

The official residence of the governor-general was built as two separate houses in the 17th century. In 1801, Lord Lavington of Carlisle acquired the house. Renovations are expected to be completed Jan 2026.
Dates from the 6th century and covers an area of about 20 ha. It consists of a wall and moat. The surviving walls are up to 30 m high.
Well worth a visit. Its history is unclear but it is certainly one of Afghanistan's most important historical buildings.
The present baroque church dates from 1698. Well preserved frescoes depict scenes from the life of Virgin Mary. Ring the wishing bell, which was installed in the original Gothic church in 1534.
This museum is nearer the highway to Yerevan, and has beautiful traditional architecture, interesting rooms, and a cool dining room where you can order a meal ahead of time.

n.en: Museum of National Architecture and Urban Life

items.d: A design by architect Wolff Schoemaker. Built as the headquarters of the Insulinde oil factory. Nowadays in use as the headquarters of the BJB Syariah bank.
It is a complex cultural space where you can enjoy various sea creatures and contents through media art as well as living creatures.
Yarmouk University campus - considered by many the finest archeological museum in the country, designed in partnership with the German government.
A picturesque town with waterfalls. The falls are a few kilometers from town but a fairly easy walk. There is also a farm with a lake and gardens nearby.
Very nice bridge over river Sosz with the wide views on the nearby beaches and Gomel Palace. In front of bridge is a monument to a fisherman on a boat.
This was established in the 12th century. Dorogozhychi quarter played an important role in the historical destiny of Kyiv.

n.en: Church of St. Cyril and St. Athanasius the Great, Archbp. of Alexandria and Athanasius

items.d: Beautiful belltower which provides you a great panoramic view of Split, nearby islands and Marjan hill. The ascent is certainly not for those with vertigo, but the views from the top are marvelous.
Run by the same people that also run Burg Rabenstein, a nearby castle, this cave offers breathtaking limestone formations and an honest to god, real cave bear skeleton that was discovered on site.
A collection of two dozen military aircraft.
Beautiful neoclassical building with interior decorated in 19th-century spirit and a dominating Lenin statue on the stairs to the upper floors.
The mosque is named after a famous theologian who lived and was buried in this area (there is a cemetery in the back). It has a beautiful hall.
40 km from Bahía Negra, by the Río Negro, there is this biologic station, which is the first marshland investigation centre in Paraguay, covering 15,000 ha.
The wooden railway station.
Decorated with floor beds and fountains and lined with trees it is dominated by a horse mounted statue of King Tomislav.
Coastal cave, popular with hikers and explorers for its dramatic sea views and local legends.

You can grasp the true essence of Korean Buddhist culture through this 16-m Buddhist statue. The grand scale of the statue along with the benevolent smile on its delicate expression is so beautiful that it moves anyone who sees…
Zoo and herbarium with animal skeletons on display too.

n.en: Botanical and Zoological Garden of Tsimbazaza
